nodes.title: Start here
widgets_values:
# Pika + Character Swap V1.5 · guided

1. Upload a source video and a character reference.
2. Edit Swap instructions: source is <Video 1>, character is <Picture 1>.
3. Upload an edited scene frame and choose its frame index in Add guide. It is a timed guide, never an extra Picture reference.
4. Run. Output keeps source audio and removes model padding.

Default: first 5 seconds, up to 0.5 MP, 24 fps; six steps, LCM/simple. Pika 1.0 + V1.5 0.8.

nodes.title: Installation · exact models
widgets_values:
# Models & custom nodes

Install current ComfyUI with native MiniMax H3 support. Install [H3 Relay](https://github.com/akatz-ai/h3-relay) at the revision documented in this folder. FFmpeg/ffprobe must be on PATH.

- [H3 text encoder](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/e5eb578a89295337b8ff433a035929ce0279e0b6/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

  Save as: **models/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors**

- [H3 audio VAE](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/e5eb578a89295337b8ff433a035929ce0279e0b6/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

  Save as: **models/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors**

- [H3 video VAE](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/e5eb578a89295337b8ff433a035929ce0279e0b6/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)

  Save as: **models/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors**

- [MiniMax H3 FL2VA](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/54472221d27c695fca9621b0c3ed52f06c4af707/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_int8_convrot.safetensors)

  Save as: **models/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_int8_convrot.safetensors**

- [Character Swap LoRA V1.5](https://huggingface.co/akatz-ai/MiniMax-H3-Character-Swap-LoRA/resolve/0f409f0c2a18f123f3985041ec52982c813f5a9c/h3_character_swap_v1.5.safetensors)

  Save as: **models/loras/h3-v2-challenge-eval-20261013/v2-1000.safetensors**

- [Pika H3 Flex FL2VA](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/54472221d27c695fca9621b0c3ed52f06c4af707/loras/pika_h3_flex_fl2va_v1_bf16.safetensors)

  Save as: **models/loras/pika_h3_flex_fl2va_v1_bf16.safetensors**

V1.5 filename: download h3_character_swap_v1.5.safetensors, then save under the catalog alias above or select your filename in its LoRA loader.

Weights are separate downloads; upstream model licenses apply. No SAM model is needed for these examples.

24 GB GPU: enable dynamic VRAM/model offloading. Do not force full VRAM residency.

nodes.title: Size, timing & guides
widgets_values:
# Size & timing

Prepare source resolution **480** means a 0.5 MP cap; **768** means a 1 MP cap, not a fixed pixel height. Aspect is fitted to a 32-pixel grid.

Default duration is 5 seconds. Use 0 only for short clips; keep prepared length within **362 frames (about 15 seconds at 24 fps)**. Longer videos should be split before this single-window workflow.

The model pads to 17n + 5 frames. Remove model padding restores the real source frame count. Original source audio is muxed back into the result.

This example does not run multi-window Relay continuation or SAM. The editor handles those separately.

Guided variant: frame 0 is the first output frame. Use an edited scene frame with matching composition. Duplicate Add Guide + Load Image + resize to add more timed guides; chain conditioning, keep the same latent. Guides are not character-reference Pictures.
